nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
KRISH FIXES
- Prep pads frames to 8n+1 and size to a multiple of 32 BEFORE the latent is sized (nothing dropped).
- Audio Prep pads the source audio to the padded video length.
- Restore trims frames back to the exact original count/size; Parity errors if they differ.
- Audio Restore trims the audio to the original duration.
- Final upscale: lanczos. Keep both Resize nodes at the same value (a multiple of 32).
